    "auto_pad": { "values": ["NOTSET", "SAME_UPPER", "SAME_LOWER", "VALID"] },

    "storage_order": { "values": [0, 1] },

  },

    "dilationsLengthOk": "not has(attrs, \"dilations\") or (attrs.dilations | length) == spatialRank",
    "padsLengthOk": "not has(attrs, \"pads\") or (attrs.pads | length) == 2 * spatialRank",

    "kernelW": "attrs.kernel_shape[spatialRank - 1] if kernelShapeLengthOk and has(attrs, \"kernel_shape\") and spatialRank >= 1 else 1",

{
  "domain": "com.microsoft",
  "name": "EngramGate",
  "sinceVersion": 1,
  "inputs": {
    "keyT": { "onnx": "key", "dtype": "T", "rank": 4 },
    "queryT": { "onnx": "query", "dtype": "T", "rank": 4 },
    "valueT": { "onnx": "value", "dtype": "T", "rank": 3 },
    "keyNormScaleT": { "onnx": "key_norm_scale", "dtype": "T", "rank": 2 },
    "queryNormScaleT": { "onnx": "query_norm_scale", "dtype": "T", "rank": 2 }
  },
  "outputs": { "outputT": { "onnx": "output", "dtype": "T", "rank": 4, "shape": "shapes.keyT" } },
  "attributes": { "epsilon": { "default": 0.00001 } },
  "typeConstraints": { "T": ["float32", "float16"] },
  "tunables": {
    "WORKGROUP_SIZE": { "default": 256 },
    "LANE_WORDS": { "default": 8 },
    "MIN_ROW_GROUPS": { "default": 8 }
  },
  "derive": {
    "deviceWorkgroupCap": "min(device.limits.maxComputeInvocationsPerWorkgroup, device.limits.maxComputeWorkgroupSizeX)",
    "foldedDispatchCapacity": "min(device.limits.maxComputeWorkgroupsPerDimension, 65535) * min(device.limits.maxComputeWorkgroupsPerDimension, 65535)",
    "hcMult": "dim(shapes.keyT, 2)",
    "hidden": "dim(shapes.keyT, 3)",
    "rowCount": "dim(shapes.keyT, 0) * dim(shapes.keyT, 1) * hcMult",
    "dtypeOk": "tensorDtypes.keyT == tensorDtypes.queryT and tensorDtypes.keyT == tensorDtypes.valueT and tensorDtypes.keyT == tensorDtypes.keyNormScaleT and tensorDtypes.keyT == tensorDtypes.queryNormScaleT and tensorDtypes.keyT == tensorDtypes.outputT and f16Ok(dtypes.T)",
    "shapeOk": "ranks.keyT == 4 and ranks.valueT == 3 and hidden > 0 and hcMult > 0 and rowCount > 0 and sameShape(shapes.queryT, shapes.keyT) and sameShape(shapes.outputT, shapes.keyT) and sameShape(prefix(shapes.valueT, 2), prefix(shapes.keyT, 2)) and dim(shapes.valueT, 2) == hidden and sameShape(shapes.keyNormScaleT, suffix(shapes.keyT, 2)) and sameShape(shapes.queryNormScaleT, suffix(shapes.keyT, 2))",
    "contractOk": "dtypeOk and shapeOk",
    "workgroupOk": "tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE > 0 and tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE <= deviceWorkgroupCap and pow2ceil(tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE) == tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE and tunables.LANE_WORDS > 0 and tunables.MIN_ROW_GROUPS > 0",
    "sharedFoldFits": "tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE * 16 <= device.limits.maxComputeWorkgroupStorageSize",
    "vec4Ok": "hidden % 4 == 0",
    "vecWords": "hidden / 4",
    "vecPreferredLanes": "max(1, min(tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE / 2, pow2ceil(max(1, ceilDiv(vecWords, max(1, tunables.LANE_WORDS))))))",
    "vecWideLanes": "max(1, min(tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE, pow2ceil(max(1, ceilDiv(vecWords, max(1, tunables.LANE_WORDS))))))",
    "vecBaseLanes": "pick([[ceilDiv(vecWords, vecPreferredLanes) <= 8, vecPreferredLanes]], vecWideLanes)",
    "vecBaseRowGroups": "ceilDiv(rowCount, max(1, tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE / max(1, vecBaseLanes)))",
    "vecFillLanes": "max(1, min(min(tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE, pow2ceil(max(1, vecWords))), pow2ceil(max(1, ceilDiv(tunables.MIN_ROW_GROUPS * tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE, max(1, rowCount))))))",
    "vecLanesPerRow": "pick([[vecBaseRowGroups < tunables.MIN_ROW_GROUPS, max(vecBaseLanes, vecFillLanes)]], vecBaseLanes)",
    "vecRowsPerGroup": "tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE / max(1, vecLanesPerRow)",
    "vecWordsPerLane": "ceilDiv(vecWords, max(1, vecLanesPerRow))",
    "vecRowGroups": "ceilDiv(rowCount, max(1, vecRowsPerGroup))",
    "scalarPreferredLanes": "max(1, min(tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE / 2, pow2ceil(max(1, ceilDiv(hidden, max(8, tunables.LANE_WORDS))))))",
    "scalarWideLanes": "max(1, min(tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE, pow2ceil(max(1, ceilDiv(hidden, max(1, tunables.LANE_WORDS))))))",
    "scalarBaseLanes": "pick([[ceilDiv(hidden, scalarPreferredLanes) <= 8, scalarPreferredLanes]], scalarWideLanes)",
    "scalarBaseRowGroups": "ceilDiv(rowCount, max(1, tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE / max(1, scalarBaseLanes)))",
    "scalarFillLanes": "max(1, min(min(tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE, pow2ceil(max(1, hidden))), pow2ceil(max(1, ceilDiv(tunables.MIN_ROW_GROUPS * tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE, max(1, rowCount))))))",
    "scalarLanesPerRow": "pick([[scalarBaseRowGroups < tunables.MIN_ROW_GROUPS, max(scalarBaseLanes, scalarFillLanes)]], scalarBaseLanes)",
    "scalarRowsPerGroup": "tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE / max(1, scalarLanesPerRow)",
    "scalarWordsPerLane": "ceilDiv(hidden, max(1, scalarLanesPerRow))",
    "scalarRowGroups": "ceilDiv(rowCount, max(1, scalarRowsPerGroup))",
    "subgroupShapeKnown": "device.features.has(\"subgroups\") and has(device.adapterInfo, \"subgroupMinSize\") and has(device.adapterInfo, \"subgroupMaxSize\") and device.adapterInfo.subgroupMinSize > 0 and device.adapterInfo.subgroupMinSize <= device.adapterInfo.subgroupMaxSize and device.adapterInfo.subgroupMaxSize <= tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE and tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE % device.adapterInfo.subgroupMaxSize == 0",
    "sgMin": "device.adapterInfo.subgroupMinSize if subgroupShapeKnown else 0",
    "sgFullWidth": "subgroupShapeKnown and device.adapterInfo.subgroupMinSize == device.adapterInfo.subgroupMaxSize",
    "sgVecLanesPerRow": "min(sgMin, vecLanesPerRow) if subgroupShapeKnown else 1",
    "sgVecRowsPerGroup": "tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE / max(1, sgVecLanesPerRow)",
    "sgVecWordsPerLane": "ceilDiv(vecWords, max(1, sgVecLanesPerRow))",
    "sgVecRowGroups": "ceilDiv(rowCount, max(1, sgVecRowsPerGroup))",
    "sgScalarLanesPerRow": "min(sgMin, scalarLanesPerRow) if subgroupShapeKnown else 1",
    "sgScalarRowsPerGroup": "tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE / max(1, sgScalarLanesPerRow)",
    "sgScalarWordsPerLane": "ceilDiv(hidden, max(1, sgScalarLanesPerRow))",
    "sgScalarRowGroups": "ceilDiv(rowCount, max(1, sgScalarRowsPerGroup))",
    "vectorElement": "\"vec4<\" ~ dtypes.T ~ \">\"",
    "workgroupSize": "tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE",
    "epsilon": "attrs.epsilon",
    "scalar": "dtypes.T",
    "vectorScalar": "vectorElement"
  },
  "when": ["contractOk", "workgroupOk"],
  "bindings": {
    "key": { "arg": "keyT", "elementType": "$vectorElement" },
    "query": { "arg": "queryT", "elementType": "$vectorElement" },
    "value": { "arg": "valueT", "elementType": "$vectorElement" },
    "kscale": { "arg": "keyNormScaleT", "elementType": "$vectorElement" },
    "qscale": { "arg": "queryNormScaleT", "elementType": "$vectorElement" },
    "out": { "arg": "outputT", "elementType": "$vectorElement" },
    "key_main": { "arg": "keyT", "name": "key", "elementType": "$scalar" },
    "query_main": { "arg": "queryT", "name": "query", "elementType": "$scalar" },
    "value_main": { "arg": "valueT", "name": "value", "elementType": "$scalar" },
    "kscale_main": { "arg": "keyNormScaleT", "name": "kscale", "elementType": "$scalar" },
    "qscale_main": { "arg": "queryNormScaleT", "name": "qscale", "elementType": "$scalar" },
    "out_main": { "arg": "outputT", "name": "out", "elementType": "$scalar" },
    "params": { "struct": [{ "name": "rows", "type": "u32", "value": "rowCount" }] }
  },
  "variants": [
    {
      "id": "subgroup_rows_vec4",
      "priority": 30,
      "when": ["vec4Ok", "subgroupShapeKnown", "sgVecWordsPerLane >= 1", "sgVecWordsPerLane <= 8", "sgVecRowGroups <= foldedDispatchCapacity"],
      "requires": { "features": ["subgroups"] },
      "derive": {
        "foldKind": "\"none\" if sgVecLanesPerRow <= 1 else (\"subgroup_full\" if (sgFullWidth and sgVecLanesPerRow == sgMin) else \"subgroup_butterfly\")",
        "foldSteps": "log2ceil(sgVecLanesPerRow)",
        "useVec4": "true",
        "stageRow": "true",
        "rowWords": "vecWords",
        "wordsPerLane": "sgVecWordsPerLane",
        "lanesPerRow": "sgVecLanesPerRow",
        "rowsPerGroup": "sgVecRowsPerGroup"
      },
      "passes": [
        {
          "id": "main",
          "name": "EngramGate.SubgroupRowsVec4",
          "shader": "engram-gate-rows.wgsl.jinja",
          "bindings": ["key", "query", "value", "kscale", "qscale", "out", "params"],
          "dispatch": {
            "x": "min(sgVecRowGroups, DISPATCH_FOLD_WIDTH)",
            "y": "ceilDiv(sgVecRowGroups, DISPATCH_FOLD_WIDTH)"
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "packed_rows_vec4",
      "priority": 20,
      "when": ["vec4Ok", "sharedFoldFits", "vecRowGroups <= foldedDispatchCapacity"],
      "derive": {
        "foldKind": "\"none\" if vecLanesPerRow <= 1 else \"workgroup_tree\"",
        "foldSteps": "log2ceil(vecLanesPerRow)",
        "useVec4": "true",
        "stageRow": "vecWordsPerLane <= 8",
        "rowWords": "vecWords",
        "wordsPerLane": "vecWordsPerLane",
        "lanesPerRow": "vecLanesPerRow",
        "rowsPerGroup": "vecRowsPerGroup"
      },
      "passes": [
        {
          "id": "main",
          "name": "EngramGate.PackedRowsVec4",
          "shader": "engram-gate-rows.wgsl.jinja",
          "bindings": ["key", "query", "value", "kscale", "qscale", "out", "params"],
          "dispatch": {
            "x": "min(vecRowGroups, DISPATCH_FOLD_WIDTH)",
            "y": "ceilDiv(vecRowGroups, DISPATCH_FOLD_WIDTH)"
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "subgroup_rows_scalar",
      "priority": 10,
      "when": ["subgroupShapeKnown", "sgScalarWordsPerLane >= 1", "sgScalarWordsPerLane <= 8", "sgScalarRowGroups <= foldedDispatchCapacity"],
      "requires": { "features": ["subgroups"] },
      "derive": {
        "foldKind": "\"none\" if sgScalarLanesPerRow <= 1 else (\"subgroup_full\" if (sgFullWidth and sgScalarLanesPerRow == sgMin) else \"subgroup_butterfly\")",
        "foldSteps": "log2ceil(sgScalarLanesPerRow)",
        "useVec4": "false",
        "stageRow": "true",
        "rowWords": "hidden",
        "wordsPerLane": "sgScalarWordsPerLane",
        "lanesPerRow": "sgScalarLanesPerRow",
        "rowsPerGroup": "sgScalarRowsPerGroup"
      },
      "passes": [
        {
          "id": "main",
          "name": "EngramGate.SubgroupRowsScalar",
          "shader": "engram-gate-rows.wgsl.jinja",
          "bindings": ["key_main", "query_main", "value_main", "kscale_main", "qscale_main", "out_main", "params"],
          "dispatch": {
            "x": "min(sgScalarRowGroups, DISPATCH_FOLD_WIDTH)",
            "y": "ceilDiv(sgScalarRowGroups, DISPATCH_FOLD_WIDTH)"
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "packed_rows_scalar",
      "priority": 0,
      "when": ["sharedFoldFits", "scalarRowGroups <= foldedDispatchCapacity"],
      "derive": {
        "foldKind": "\"none\" if scalarLanesPerRow <= 1 else \"workgroup_tree\"",
        "foldSteps": "log2ceil(scalarLanesPerRow)",
        "useVec4": "false",
        "stageRow": "scalarWordsPerLane <= 8",
        "rowWords": "hidden",
        "wordsPerLane": "scalarWordsPerLane",
        "lanesPerRow": "scalarLanesPerRow",
        "rowsPerGroup": "scalarRowsPerGroup"
      },
      "passes": [
        {
          "id": "main",
          "name": "EngramGate.PackedRowsScalar",
          "shader": "engram-gate-rows.wgsl.jinja",
          "bindings": ["key_main", "query_main", "value_main", "kscale_main", "qscale_main", "out_main", "params"],
          "dispatch": {
            "x": "min(scalarRowGroups, DISPATCH_FOLD_WIDTH)",
            "y": "ceilDiv(scalarRowGroups, DISPATCH_FOLD_WIDTH)"
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  ]

{

  "typeConstraints": { "T": ["float32", "float16"] },

    "normSize": "numel(shapes.scaleT)",
    "lastDim": "dim(shapes.xT, ranks.xT - 1)",
    "elementCount": "numel(shapes.xT)",
    "rowCount": "elementCount / max(1, normSize)",
    "dtypeOk": "tensorDtypes.xT == tensorDtypes.scaleT and tensorDtypes.xT == tensorDtypes.gateT and tensorDtypes.xT == tensorDtypes.yT and f16Ok(dtypes.T)",

    "workgroupOk": "tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE > 0 and tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE <= deviceWorkgroupCap and pow2ceil(tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE) == tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE and tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE * 4 <= device.limits.maxComputeWorkgroupStorageSize and tunables.LANE_WORDS > 0",

    "vecWideLanes": "max(1, min(tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE, pow2ceil(max(1, ceilDiv(vecWords, max(1, tunables.LANE_WORDS))))))",
    "vecLanesPerRow": "pick([[ceilDiv(vecWords, vecPreferredLanes) <= 8, vecPreferredLanes]], vecWideLanes)",
    "vecRowsPerGroup": "tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE / max(1, vecLanesPerRow)",
    "vecWordsPerLane": "ceilDiv(vecWords, max(1, vecLanesPerRow))",

    "scalarPreferredLanes": "1 if normSize <= 8 else (max(1, min(tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE / 2, pow2ceil(max(1, ceilDiv(normSize, max(1, tunables.LANE_WORDS)))))))",
    "scalarWideLanes": "max(1, min(tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE, pow2ceil(max(1, ceilDiv(normSize, max(1, tunables.LANE_WORDS))))))",
    "scalarLanesPerRow": "pick([[ceilDiv(normSize, scalarPreferredLanes) <= 8, scalarPreferredLanes]], scalarWideLanes)",
    "scalarRowsPerGroup": "tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE / max(1, scalarLanesPerRow)",
    "scalarWordsPerLane": "ceilDiv(normSize, max(1, scalarLanesPerRow))",

    "workgroupSize": "tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE",

  "when": ["contractOk", "workgroupOk"],

    "gate_main": { "arg": "gateT", "name": "gate", "elementType": "$scalar" },
    "y_y_t": { "arg": "yT", "name": "y", "elementType": "$scalar" },
    "params": { "struct": [{ "name": "rows", "type": "u32", "value": "rowCount" }] }
  },
  "variants": [

{

  "name": "GatedRelativePositionBias",

  "inputs": {
    "queryLayerT": { "onnx": "query_layer", "dtype": "T", "rank": 3 },
    "queryBiasT": { "onnx": "query_bias", "dtype": "T", "rank": 1 },

    "weightT": { "onnx": "weight", "dtype": "T", "rank": 2 },
    "biasT": { "onnx": "bias", "dtype": "T", "rank": 1 },

  },
  "outputs": {
    "outputT": {
      "onnx": "output",
      "dtype": "T",
      "rank": 4,
      "shape": "[dim(shapes.queryLayerT, 0), attrs.num_heads, dim(shapes.queryLayerT, 1), dim(shapes.queryLayerT, 1)]"
    }
  },
  "attributes": { "num_heads": {} },
  "attributeConstraints": { "num_heads": { "required": true } },
  "typeConstraints": { "T": ["float32", "float16"] },
  "tunables": { "WORKGROUP_SIZE": { "default": 128 }, "LANE_WORDS": { "default": 2 } },
  "derive": {
    "deviceWorkgroupCap": "min(device.limits.maxComputeInvocationsPerWorkgroup, device.limits.maxComputeWorkgroupSizeX)",
    "foldedDispatchCapacity": "min(device.limits.maxComputeWorkgroupsPerDimension, 65535) * min(device.limits.maxComputeWorkgroupsPerDimension, 65535)",
    "variableSubgroup16To32": "device.features.has(\"subgroups\") and has(device.adapterInfo, \"subgroupMinSize\") and has(device.adapterInfo, \"subgroupMaxSize\") and device.adapterInfo.subgroupMinSize == 16 and device.adapterInfo.subgroupMaxSize == 32",
    "batchSize": "dim(shapes.queryLayerT, 0)",
    "seqLen": "dim(shapes.queryLayerT, 1)",
    "queryHidden": "dim(shapes.queryLayerT, 2)",
    "numHeads": "attrs.num_heads",
    "headSize": "queryHidden / max(1, numHeads)",
    "projDim": "dim(shapes.weightT, 1)",
    "halfProj": "projDim / 2",
    "rowCount": "batchSize * numHeads * seqLen",
    "dtypeOk": "tensorDtypes.queryLayerT == tensorDtypes.queryBiasT and tensorDtypes.queryLayerT == tensorDtypes.relPosT and tensorDtypes.queryLayerT == tensorDtypes.weightT and tensorDtypes.queryLayerT == tensorDtypes.biasT and tensorDtypes.queryLayerT == tensorDtypes.ecoAT and tensorDtypes.queryLayerT == tensorDtypes.outputT and f16Ok(dtypes.T)",
    "headsOk": "numHeads > 0 and queryHidden > 0 and queryHidden % numHeads == 0 and headSize > 0",
    "projOk": "ranks.weightT == 2 and dim(shapes.weightT, 0) == headSize and projDim > 0 and projDim % 2 == 0 and projDim <= 32 and ranks.biasT == 1 and dim(shapes.biasT, 0) == projDim",
    "relPosOk": "ranks.relPosT == 4 and dim(shapes.relPosT, 0) == 1 and dim(shapes.relPosT, 1) == numHeads and dim(shapes.relPosT, 2) == seqLen and dim(shapes.relPosT, 3) == seqLen",
    "ecoOk": "ranks.ecoAT == 4 and numel(shapes.ecoAT) == numHeads",
    "outputOk": "ranks.outputT == 4 and dim(shapes.outputT, 0) == batchSize and dim(shapes.outputT, 1) == numHeads and dim(shapes.outputT, 2) == seqLen and dim(shapes.outputT, 3) == seqLen",
    "biasOk": "ranks.queryBiasT == 1 and dim(shapes.queryBiasT, 0) == queryHidden",
    "contractOk": "ranks.queryLayerT == 3 and seqLen > 0 and dtypeOk and headsOk and projOk and relPosOk and ecoOk and outputOk and biasOk",
    "workgroupOk": "tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE > 0 and tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE <= deviceWorkgroupCap and pow2ceil(tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE) == tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE and tunables.LANE_WORDS > 0 and headSize + tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE * 2 + 1 <= device.limits.maxComputeWorkgroupStorageSize / 4",
    "dispatchOk": "rowCount <= foldedDispatchCapacity",
    "vec4Ok": "seqLen % 4 == 0",
    "vecWords": "seqLen / 4",
    "vecWorkgroup": "max(32, min(tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE, pow2ceil(max(1, ceilDiv(vecWords, max(1, tunables.LANE_WORDS))))))",
    "scalarWorkgroup": "max(32, min(tunables.WORKGROUP_SIZE, pow2ceil(max(1, ceilDiv(seqLen, max(1, tunables.LANE_WORDS))))))",
    "vecWordsPerLane": "ceilDiv(vecWords, max(1, vecWorkgroup))",
    "scalarWordsPerLane": "ceilDiv(seqLen, max(1, scalarWorkgroup))",
    "vectorElement": "\"vec4<\" ~ dtypes.T ~ \">\"",
    "projectionLaneWidth": "min(vecWorkgroup, scalarWorkgroup, device.adapterInfo.subgroupMinSize) if (has(device.adapterInfo, \"subgroupMinSize\") and device.adapterInfo.subgroupMinSize > 0) else min(vecWorkgroup, scalarWorkgroup, 32)",

    "useVec4": "vec4Ok",
    "rowWords": "vecWords if vec4Ok else seqLen",
    "wordsPerLane": "vecWordsPerLane if vec4Ok else scalarWordsPerLane",
    "stageRow": "wordsPerLane <= 8",
    "workgroupSize": "vecWorkgroup if vec4Ok else scalarWorkgroup",
    "scalar": "dtypes.T",
    "vectorScalar": "vectorElement",
    "rowElement": "vectorElement if vec4Ok else scalar"
  },
  "when": ["contractOk", "workgroupOk", "dispatchOk"],
  "bindings": {
    "query_layer": { "arg": "queryLayerT", "elementType": "$scalar" },
    "query_bias": { "arg": "queryBiasT", "elementType": "$scalar" },
    "weight": { "arg": "weightT", "elementType": "$scalar" },
    "bias": { "arg": "biasT", "elementType": "$scalar" },
    "eco_a": { "arg": "ecoAT", "elementType": "$scalar" },
    "rel_pos": { "arg": "relPosT", "elementType": "$rowElement" },
    "output": { "arg": "outputT", "elementType": "$rowElement" },
    "params": { "struct": [{ "name": "seqLen", "type": "u32", "value": "seqLen" }] }
  },
  "variants": [
    {
      "id": "row",
      "priority": 10,
      "passes": [
        {
          "id": "main",
          "name": "GatedRelativePositionBias.Row",
          "shader": "gated-relative-position-bias.wgsl.jinja",
          "bindings": ["query_layer", "query_bias", "weight", "bias", "eco_a", "rel_pos", "output", "params"],
          "dispatch": { "x": "min(rowCount, DISPATCH_FOLD_WIDTH)", "y": "ceilDiv(rowCount, DISPATCH_FOLD_WIDTH)" }
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "row_head_tree",
      "priority": 30,
      "when": ["true"],
      "demoteWhen": ["not headParallelPreferred"],
      "requires": { "features": [] },
      "derive": { "parallelProjection": true, "useSubgroups": false },
      "passes": [
        {
          "id": "main",
          "name": "GatedRelativePositionBias.RowHeadTree",
          "shader": "gated-relative-position-bias.wgsl.jinja",
          "bindings": ["query_layer", "query_bias", "weight", "bias", "eco_a", "rel_pos", "output", "params"],
          "dispatch": { "x": "min(rowCount, DISPATCH_FOLD_WIDTH)", "y": "ceilDiv(rowCount, DISPATCH_FOLD_WIDTH)" }
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "row_head_subgroups",
      "priority": 40,
      "when": ["device.wgslLanguageFeatures.has(\"subgroup_id\")"],
      "demoteWhen": ["not headParallelPreferred"],
      "requires": { "features": ["subgroups"] },
      "derive": { "parallelProjection": true, "useSubgroups": true },
      "passes": [
        {
          "id": "main",
          "name": "GatedRelativePositionBias.RowHeadSubgroups",
          "shader": "gated-relative-position-bias.wgsl.jinja",
          "bindings": ["query_layer", "query_bias", "weight", "bias", "eco_a", "rel_pos", "output", "params"],
          "dispatch": { "x": "min(rowCount, DISPATCH_FOLD_WIDTH)", "y": "ceilDiv(rowCount, DISPATCH_FOLD_WIDTH)" }
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
